name: baseline
notes: shipped defaults: silenceDurationMs=1200, silenceThreshold=1000, FASTER_WHISPER large-v3-turbo CPU int8

name: silence-duration 1200->600 / conversation 1500->800
notes: drop silence wait by 600ms; observed -792ms (slight overshoot from warm STT)

name: silence-duration 600->300 / conversation 800->500
notes: aggressive silence wait; matches commercial voice assistants. silence-wait knob largely milked, STT is now ~94% of total.

name: STT backend FASTER_WHISPER -> WHISPER_CPP (Vulkan iGPU)
edits: EouLatencyBench: refactor to load AudioProperties+SpeechToTextProperties from application.properties (kills bench/prod drift)
autoresearch.sh: also bring up whisper-cpp container
notes: whisper.cpp Vulkan on AMD Radeon 780M iGPU is ~3.24x faster per HTTP round-trip than faster-whisper CPU int8. STT now ~1.6s, silence wait ~450ms. Sigma tightened from ~65ms to ~14ms.

name: silence-duration 300->200
notes: matches Siri-class silence wait. 200ms is near the lower safe bound; below 200ms variance in frame timing dominates.

name: refactor: extract AudioFraming + skip trailing-silence frames into SttGate
edits: new IO/InputHandling/AudioFraming.java (LP_FILTER, isSilence, downsample as public static)
WakeWordProducer: delegate isSilence/downsample to AudioFraming; only sttGate.processAudio for non-silent frames (both initial and conversation loops)
EouLatencyBench: mirror non-silent-only buffering + use AudioFraming statics
notes: algorithm change was neutral (-0.4%, within noise). Refactor kept for code quality / no bench-prod drift. Existing tests still pass (11/11). Hypothesis that whisper.cpp encoder pads <30s audio to 30s mel and so doesn't care about trailing silence appears confirmed.

name: whisper-server decode flags: --best-of 1 --no-fallback --suppress-nst
edits: ARCOS/docker-compose.yml: command: override for whisper-cpp with decode flags
notes: no measurable improvement; bench fixture is encoder-bound (noise -> minimal decoder tokens) so decode-tuning is unmeasurable here. Reverted. Flags would likely help on real-speech production audio but the autoresearch protocol requires evidence here. Plan: iter 7 = speculative STT to overlap silence wait.

name: speculative STT: launch HTTP call at silence-onset, overlap with silenceDurationMs wait
edits: WakeWordProducer: speculationExecutor field + awaitSpeculationOrTranscribe helper; both audio loops launch at first silent frame, orphan on speech resume
EouLatencyBench: mirror speculative pattern with per-run executor
notes: predicted ~1700ms (full overlap); observed 1814ms. ~100ms residual gap = OkHttp/Vulkan call-init time on top of pure STT round-trip. Variance dropped to ~10ms. Regression tests SttGateTest 9/9 + AudioPropertiesTest 2/2 pass.

name: whisper-server --audio-ctx 500 (cap mel context 30s->10s)
notes: Encoder attention is O(n^2) over mel context. Default 1500 mel-frames (30s) is wasteful for short utterances. 500 frames = 10s cap, generous for ARCOS query workload (<5s typical). Raw HTTP after warmup: 0.48-0.60s vs 1.80s baseline. RISK: utterances >10s are truncated; should be validated against real-speech fixture before shipping. Cold start +800ms one-time for Vulkan shader recompile.
